arguments.cmd:
cd /tmp/flexonly && python - <<'EOF'
# motions line has unbalanced brackets: [["m", ...]]]] -> check: ["motions", [ MOTION ]] where MOTION=["m", ["leaf"], "slide", [0,-1,0], [0,0.5], FLEX]. FLEX=["flex",[[...]]] so MOTION ends with ]] then motions closes ]]. Total: ["motions", [ [...] ]] = [["m"...]]]] -> [["m", ["leaf"], "slide", [0,-1,0], [0,0.5], ["flex", [["leaf","block",0.5,"test",[2,10]]]]]]
src = open('model.scad').read()
old = '''        ["motions", [["m", ["leaf"], "slide", [0, -1, 0], [0, 0.5],
            ["flex", [["leaf", "block", 0.5, "test", [2, 10]]]]]],'''
new = '''        ["motions", [["m", ["leaf"], "slide", [0, -1, 0], [0, 0.5],
            ["flex", [["leaf", "block", 0.5, "test", [2, 10]]]]]]],'''
assert src.count(old)==1
open('model.scad','w').write(src.replace(old,new))
print("ok")
EOF
openscad -o /tmp/x.stl model.scad -D 'part="assembly"' 2>&1 | head -3
timeout 200 cadcheck assembly --out-dir /tmp/flexonly/aout model.scad 2>&1 | python -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('ok:',d['ok']); print('G3:',d['problems']['G3'][:2]); print('G4:',str(d['problems']['G4'])[:1500])"

result.stdout:
ok
ECHO: cadverify_spec = [["bounds", [[0, 0, 0], [30, 25, 12]]], ["allowed_interferences", []], ["motions", [["m", ["leaf"], "slide", [0, -1, 0], [0, 0.5], ["flex", [["leaf", "block", 0.5, "test", [2, 10]]]]]]], ["assembly_order", [[["leaf"], [0, 0, 0]], [["block"], [0, -2, 0]]]], ["material", "PLA"]]
ECHO: cadverify_instance = ["leaf", "leaf", 1]
ECHO: cadverify_instance = ["block", "block", 1]
ok: False
G3: ["the instance leaf says it is the part 'leaf', which is neither a printable option of the part selector ([]), 'external' nor a standard:<module> of cadverify_parts.scad", "the instance block says it is the part 'block', which is neither a printable option of the part selector ([]), 'external' nor a standard:<module> of cadverify_parts.scad"]
G4: ['motion m: leaf and block never overlap along it, so nothing bends: a flex is a feature that rides over what it presses on (a detent, a catch). Make it meet that, or leave the flex out']
